title: M5Stack Tab5 · C145
summary: 以ESP32-P4为主控、ESP32-C6提供无线连接的5英寸触摸终端，具备摄像头、音频和工业扩展接口。C145不含电池，K145套装另列。

facts.label: Antenna
facts.value: Built-in 3D antenna & 2 x MMCX external antenna ports

facts.label: Display
facts.value: Uses a 5‑inch IPS TFT display with a resolution of 1280×720 (720P), equipped with an integrated display and touch driver IC: ST7123 / ST7121

facts.label: Audio Chip
facts.value: ES8388 codec, ES7210 AEC front end

facts.label: RS485 Port
facts.value: SIT3088 (120Ω switchable terminal resistor); Power supply range: 6 ~ 24V

facts.label: Extensible Stamp Interface
facts.value: Stamp pads (support Cat.M / NB‑IoT / LoRaWAN and other modules)

facts.label: Motion Sensor
facts.value: BMI270 six-axis (accelerometer + gyroscope, support interrupt wake-up)

facts.label: RTC
facts.value: RTC Chip: RX8130CE (supports timed interrupt wake-up), RTC supercapacitor specification: 70000μF/3.3V, size Φ4.8×1.4mm

facts.label: Reset/Boot Button
facts.value: 1x Button, for power on/off and entering download mode

facts.label: Battery Life
facts.value: Under standard usage environment (screen brightness 50%, Wi‑Fi always on, background tasks running), Tab5 built-in battery discharges from full (8.23 V) to shutdown threshold (6.0 V), lasting about 6 hours.

facts.label: Documented body envelope
facts.notes: Viewer axes; reference drawing/source product dimensions are retained without geometric rescaling.

revisions.changes: Separate ILI9881C display + GT911 touch changed to ST7123 integrated driver.
Screen IC changed from ST7123 to ST7121.
